method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the client charged legal costs, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; dates in one module, the rules and the client's exported questions in another (each question calls a rule defined beside it), worked cases in a third; four regulative rules (ss 177, 181(4), 187(2), 187(3)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Legal Profession Uniform Law Application Act 2014 (Vic), Act No. 17/2014, Version No. 018 (incorporating amendments as at 11 October 2023), with Schedule 1 (the Legal Profession Uniform Law), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/legal-profession-uniform-law-application-act-2014.txt (committed text sha256 4487c989e6da3aa16a092157b1365706bcd4ee79a54078bcf273f3dbac2ef77f), converted from the Word file saved by hand by the owner on 2026-11-06

seat: the client charged legal costs by a law practice (for this focus typically a person bringing an injury or compensation claim on a conditional costs agreement), or a third party payer of a client's costs (lpul-client.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lpul-dates.l4 ; l4 run lpul-client.l4 ; l4 run lpul-cases-client.l4
checks.result: 158 assertions written, 158 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Legal costs as the client meets them. In (Uniform Law, Sch 1): s 6 definitions used, ss 170, 171 (as a choice), 172(4) (noted), 174, 175, 177, 178, 179, 180(2), (4), 181, 182, 183, 185, 187, 190, 191, 194, 195, 196, 197, 198 (except (6), (8)-(10)), 204, 268(3), 272(2), (3), 284(2), 291-294, Sch 4 cl 18(1)(a), (3), (4). In (Victorian Act): s 10 Tables 1 and 2, s 97 (named), s 99. Out: ss 169, 172(1)-(3), 173, 176, 180(1), (3), 184, 186, 188, 189, 192, 193, 198(6), (8)-(10), 199-203, 205-208, civil penalties, the rest of Chapter 5, Sch 4 cl 18(1)(b), (2), and the rest of the Act. Uniform General Rules rr 71, 72A and 75 read from the WA deposit of the uniform text; indexed amounts are the Law's base figures. Reasons in NOTES.md.
